description: Header file defining structures and a parser class for VP8 video stream parsing, including frame headers, segmentation, loop filter, quantization, entropy, and parsing methods.

classes.name: media::Vp8FrameHeader
classes.description: Represents the header information of a VP8 frame, including frame type, size, segmentation, and decoding parameters.

classes.name: media::Vp8Parser
classes.description: A parser class for decoding VP8 raw stream frames as specified in RFC 6386.

methods.name: media::Vp8Parser::ParseFrame
methods.description: Parses a single VP8 frame from a byte stream, filling a Vp8FrameHeader structure.
